problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: size 48 cubic feet, revenue $202
* Package 2: size 21 cubic feet, revenue $178
* Package 3: size 19 cubic feet, revenue $232
* Package 4: size 22 cubic feet, revenue $109
* Package 5: size 41 cubic feet, revenue $18
* Package 6: size 49 cubic feet, revenue $226
* Package 7: size 10 cubic feet, revenue $171
* Package 8: size 5 cubic feet, revenue $77
* Package 9: size 15 cubic feet, revenue $280
* Package 10: size 9 cubic feet, revenue $257
* Package 11: size 20 cubic feet, revenue $33
* Package 12: size 29 cubic feet, revenue $235
* Package 13: size 35 cubic feet, revenue $85
* Package 14: size 42 cubic feet, revenue $266
* Package 15: size 25 cubic feet, revenue $53
* Package 16: size 39 cubic feet, revenue $131
* Package 17: size 30 cubic feet, revenue $223
* Package 18: size 36 cubic feet, revenue $177
* Package 19: size 36 cubic feet, revenue $124
* Package 20: size 3 cubic feet, revenue $20
* Package 21: size 18 cubic feet, revenue $215
* Package 22: size 45 cubic feet, revenue $83
* Package 23: size 15 cubic feet, revenue $127
* Package 24: size 42 cubic feet, revenue $222
* Package 25: size 39 cubic feet, revenue $267
* Package 26: size 49 cubic feet, revenue $99
* Package 27: size 10 cubic feet, revenue $35
* Package 28: size 48 cubic feet, revenue $133

The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 560 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
